text:
marta: Quick postmortem for the prefetch livelock during tenant surge @ 09:12 UTC. Hypothesis and proposed fixes below.

liam: saw the alert. can you paste the logs?

marta: logs pasted 9patterns: prefetch -> demote -> immediate retry -> handoff denied -> repeat until eviction credits exhausted.

marta: ```
[09:11:57] prefetch: tenant=acme id=42 attempt=1 prefetched=0 evict_hint=hot
[09:11:57] handoff: lease=lease_123 result=DENIED demote_count=1
[09:11:58] prefetch: tenant=acme id=42 attempt=2 prefetched=0 demote_reason=tombstone
[09:11:58] handoff: lease=lease_124 result=DENIED demote_count=2
[09:11:59] prefetch: tenant=acme id=42 attempt=3 prefetched=0 demote_reason=evict_score_high
[09:11:59] handoff: lease=lease_125 result=DENIED demote_count=3
[09:12:00] prefetch: tenant=acme id=42 attempt=4 prefetched=0 backoff=0s
... loops until system trips quota
```

ana: why is backoff 0? didn't we add jittered exponential backoff last quarter?

marta: the prefetch admission path bypasses backoff when demote_reason in {tombstone, evict_score_high} to prioritize cold reads. that bypass didn't account for multi-tenant surges causing tight retry loops.

tessa: handoff DENIED gets turned into immediate retry, so no cooldown.

liam: root cause: no per-tenant retry cap and prefetch loop ignores recent demote timestamps. combined with aggressive demote policy this yields rapid churn -> livelock and tail latency.

ana: repro plan: simulate 50 tenants hammering same hot prefix, ensure handoff denies, measure retry multiplication. i'll run in perf lab.

marta: tests/metrics to add: demote_count and last_demote_ts emitted by prefetch admission, histogram of prefetch_retry_interval.

ops-bot: perf-lab job #542 queued (sim-id: prefetch-livelock-sim).

liam: quick fixes proposed:
- map handoff DENIED -> tenant_prefetch_backoff increment + exponential backoff with capped jitter (min 10ms, max 2s)
- add short-lived lease_bump token (100ms) to avoid immediate new handoff attempts after DENIED
- enforce per-tenant in-flight prefetch limit (default 2)

tessa: longer-term ideas:
- change "bypass backoff on tombstone" to "bypass only when tombstone && global_load < threshold"
- prefetch admission consults eviction-signal window (if demote_count > 2 within 1s, throttle)
- fairness token-bucket per-tenant for prefetch rate limiting

marta: implementation sketch:
```
// on handoff DENIED
retry := tenantPrefetchRetry(tenantID)
retry.backoff = min(maxBackoff, base*2^retry.attempt)
retry.attempt++
retry.scheduled_at = now + jitter(retry.backoff)
// bump lease to reduce immediate contention
bumpLease(tenantID, 100 * time.Millisecond)
```

ana: unit tests to add:
- denied->backoff mapping keeps ordering across tenants
- enforce per-tenant in-flight under concurrency
- eviction-bypass only when global_load < threshold

liam: monitoring to add: prefetch_retry_count, prefetch_retry_interval_ms, prefetch_denied_rate, lease_bump_count, per_tenant_inflight_prefetch_gauge. alert if prefetch_retry_count spikes 5x and p95 latency >200ms.

tessa: rollout: feature-flag the backoff mapping; canary 10% hosts, monitor for 2 hours then widen.

marta: owners:
- marta: implement denied->backoff + lease_bump (PR in 48h)
- ana: perf-lab repro + tests (results EOD tomorrow)
- liam: metrics + alerts + dashboard
- tessa: rollout + feature flag gating

liam: followup Q: should we add an absolute global prefetch cap to protect control-plane memory?

marta: yes. add global cap with soft-fail that returns 503 or routes to direct readpath and raises strong alert.

ana: perf-lab job started. i'll post results here.

ops-bot: canary deploy started (job #789).

marta: thanks all, opening PR with sketch and linking in thread. reconvene if perf-lab shows livelock after backoff changes. :thumbsup:
